decisions.reason: The black-finish range sits close to the core offer and moved from a mention to its own page in 2024, which suggests results at or above aspiration, and it costs little to carry, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The seamless-covering shower channel has had its own page in both years and fits the firm's barrier-free design strategy, so its consistent presence suggests it meets aspirations and should stay.

The pump-drain channel launched only in 2024 and its results are still uncertain, but the firm's growth and investment indicate slack to keep it, even though the earlier pump solution C was withdrawn and adds some risk.
